tldr: Sun through the 7th house brings focus to partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others.
body: Sun transiting the 7th house illuminates partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others. For about a month, attention, vitality, and conscious focus move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a visibility transit: it shows where your life force wants to be recognized, strengthened, and chosen consciously.
business: Sun supports relationship dynamics and agreements: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Ego inflation, overexposure, or handing your agency to someone else.
advice: Use the spotlight in the 7th house deliberately. Work with partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
